name: Tonari no Sanshimai-san ga Totsuide Kimashita!?
original_name: 異世界の三姉妹さんが嫁いできました！？
source: The protagonist Yuuri Taishi, who got summoned into another world, successfully defeated the demon lord along with three sisters Luna, Emma, and Ren. They're supposed to live their remaining lives in the current world; but due to certain reason Taishi had to go back to his own world. But one day, Taishi came home from work to unexpected guests: the three sisters from the other world. They wanted to meet Taishi so bad they performed a forbidden spell to get transferred!
translation: 主角勇利大志被召唤到异世界后，与露娜、艾玛和莲三姐妹一同成功击败了魔王。他们本打算留在那里共度余生，却因某个缘故，大志不得不返回原来的世界。某天，大志下班回家，发现三位意想不到的访客：来自异世界的三姐妹。她们实在太想见到大志，竟施展禁忌魔法，穿越世界来找他！
